decisions.reason: It is closely tied to the firm's core promise of trusted second-channel communication, so after several years of investment and public offering management is likely to justify staying the course and treat any weaker uptake as temporary.
As a core security architecture with its own product page and strong fit to the firm's R&D-heavy strategy, it carries high sunk costs and visible commitment, which makes withdrawal unlikely.

Although a hardware-based signature token could be more niche and easier to rationalize away, the dedicated presentation and fit with secure signing and authentication still make management more likely to persist than to exit.

The compliance suite builds on the established security offer and matches the firm's regulatory positioning, so management is likely to continue supporting it rather than admit a mistaken launch unless results clearly deteriorate.
